# @zakkster/lite-camera-pro

> Cinematic Canvas2D camera system for games. Zero-GC in the update/render hot
> path. Extends @zakkster/lite-camera's CinematicCamera. Adds smooth/eased zoom,
> 5 follow modes, multi-target auto-framing, and an 8-slot noise-based shake
> engine at the core "." entry; parallax, timeline sequences and a debug HUD are
> per-instance opt-ins on their own subpaths (v2.0.0 detach).

Version: 2.0.0

ESM only. `import` from `@zakkster/lite-camera-pro`. Default export is the
CinematicCameraPro class. All hot-path APIs avoid allocation; setup-time calls
(constructor, withX attach, createSequence, trackMultiple) may allocate.

v2.0.0 detach (CP-21/CP-22/CP-23): a bundler cannot drop a reachable class
method, so a class-only consumer used to ship four subsystems it never called
(DebugHUD, CameraSequence, ParallaxManager, ShakePresets) plus all of
@zakkster/lite-timeline. Those four are now SEVERED from the class and the root
barrel; the "." bundle dropped 24.49 KB -> 15.62 KB gz (~36%). Parallax,
sequences and debug come back per instance via withParallax / withSequences /
withDebug on their subpaths; presets moved to ./shake; shakePreset() was dropped.

## Install
npm install @zakkster/lite-camera-pro

## Core class
new CinematicCameraPro(viewW, viewH, worldW, worldH, seed = 42)

Game loop (once per frame):
  cam.update(dt, playerX, playerY, playerVX = 0, playerVY = 0)
Render:
  ctx.save(); cam.apply(ctx); drawWorld(ctx); ctx.restore();
- apply(ctx): translates/scales/rotates the canvas to the camera transform (includes shake).
update() dispatches by priority: active sequence > multi-target > single-target follow mode.
A class-only camera constructs with NO parallax/debug state: cam._parallax === null
and cam.debugConfig === null until the matching withX attaches (CP-22).

## Attach (v2.0.0 detach -- opt in per instance)
import { withParallax } from '@zakkster/lite-camera-pro/parallax';
import { withSequences } from '@zakkster/lite-camera-pro/sequence';
import { withDebug } from '@zakkster/lite-camera-pro/debug';
withParallax(cam);      // installs addParallaxLayer/removeParallaxLayer/applyParallax + cam._parallax
withSequences(cam);     // installs cam.createSequence(opts) -> createCameraSequence(cam, opts)
withDebug(cam);         // installs cam.debug/cam.debugHUD + cam.debugConfig
Each withX: per-instance own-property install (never prototype mutation, so two
cameras attach independently), returns cam for chaining. Single-shot -- a second
attach of the same subsystem throws ERR_ALREADY_ATTACHED (a silent re-attach
would discard live layers). No unattach: destroy() is the only exit, and
destroyed beats unattached (a post-destroy call throws ERR_CAMERA_DESTROYED, not
a not-attached code). withX on a destroyed camera also throws ERR_CAMERA_DESTROYED
(never a zombie re-attach, never ERR_ALREADY_ATTACHED). Sequences alone can skip
the attach: createCameraSequence(cam,
opts) from ./sequence works directly (every _seq site duck-types; playSequence
already accepts any ./sequence-built sequence).

## Follow modes
cam.setMode(FollowMode.SMOOTH | LOCK | PREDICTIVE | CUT | HYBRID)  // returns this
- SMOOTH: deadzone + lookahead + lerp (default).
- LOCK: instant snap, no interpolation.
- PREDICTIVE: velocity extrapolation; tune cam.predictTime (seconds).
- CUT: hard jump, zero lerp (cutscene transitions).
- HYBRID: smooth horizontal, locked vertical; cam.hybridVerticalSnap = true|false.

## Zoom
cam.setZoom(level, duration = 0, ease = null)            // smooth eased zoom; duration 0 = instant
cam.zoomAt(x, y, level, duration = 0, ease = null)        // zoom toward a static world point
cam.zoomAt(targetObj, level, duration = 0, ease = null)   // zoom toward a moving {x,y}; anchor re-read each frame
cam.minZoom, cam.maxZoom                                  // clamp limits
cam.visibleW, cam.visibleH                                // cached visible area (viewW/zoom, viewH/zoom); use for culling

## Coordinate conversion (zero-alloc, caller-owned out)
const pt = { x: 0, y: 0 };          // allocate once
cam.screenToWorld(sx, sy, pt);      // mutates pt, returns pt
cam.worldToScreen(wx, wy, pt);      // mutates pt, returns pt

## Multi-target framing
cam.trackMultiple(targets, { padding, minZoom, maxZoom, zoomSpeed, followSpeed })  // auto-zoom + center on bbox
cam.trackSingle()                                                                   // back to single-target follow
cam.setTargetCount(n)                                                               // resize without reallocating
targets: array of objects with numeric x, y.

## Shake (8 simultaneous slots, summed; simplex-noise driven)
cam.addTrauma(amount)                       // simple omnidirectional trauma (backward compatible)
cam.shake(profile, intensity = 1)           // custom: { trauma, freq, decay, maxOffset, maxAngle, dirX, dirY }
cam.clearShakes()
Named presets moved to the ./shake subpath at v2.0.0 (cam.shakePreset was dropped):
  import { getPreset } from '@zakkster/lite-camera-pro/shake';
  const p = getPreset(name); if (p) cam.shake(p, intensity);   // guard is MANDATORY (getPreset returns null on an unknown name; cam.shake(null) throws)
Preset names: 'explosion','earthquake','recoil','impact','landing','damage','rumble','heavy_impact'.
Registry (./shake exports): registerPreset(name, profile), listPresets(), getPreset(name).
Preset constants (./shake): EXPLOSION, EARTHQUAKE, RECOIL, IMPACT, LANDING, DAMAGE, RUMBLE, HEAVY_IMPACT.

## Sequences (fluent timeline; takes over position + zoom) -- withSequences or ./sequence
withSequences(cam);   // once, then:
const seq = cam.createSequence({ onComplete, blendOutTime })
  .moveTo(x, y, durationMs)
  .zoomTo(level, durationMs)
  .moveAndZoom(x, y, level, durationMs, { ease })
  .shake(presetName)
  .wait(ms)
  .call(fn);
cam.playSequence(seq);
cam.stopSequence();                 // HARD handoff: destroys the timeline (releases the shared ticker), no blend
seq.pause(); seq.resume(); seq.seek(ms);
UNITS: step durations (moveTo/zoomTo/wait/...) are MILLISECONDS (timeline units);
blendOutTime is SECONDS (class-API units, default 0.3). Different units -- do not mix.
Step position `{ at }` accepts lite-timeline syntax and honors `at: 0` (absolute t=0);
`at: undefined` appends; `at: null` appends (ignored by lite-timeline).
Completion blends camera POSITION back to follow over blendOutTime seconds (0 = hard
handoff); ZOOM is not blended (the sequence's final zoom persists).
A blend is only visible in position-lerping modes (SMOOTH, PREDICTIVE); LOCK/CUT/HYBRID
(locked vertical) write pos directly. Looping sequences never complete, so never blend.
Lifecycle triangle: pause() = resumable, ticker held, pose frozen; stop()/stopSequence() =
replayable (play() rebuilds from a fresh snapshot), ticker RELEASED, no blend; destroy() = dead.
Natural COMPLETION does not release the ticker: a completed sequence holds its timeline (and
the shared-ticker refcount) until stop()/destroy()/play() -- release long-lived completed
sequences explicitly (CP-24).
resume() is a no-op unless paused (a stopped/completed sequence is NOT replayed -- that would
re-fire its shakes and .call callbacks; use play() to replay). After stop() the timeline is
destroyed: progress reads 0 and duration falls back to the naive step-sum (an `at:'+=100'`
build reads 1600 while live, 1500 after stop). seek() rebuilds from a fresh snapshot when the
timeline was destroyed, and (like all timeline callbacks) runs user code -- shake/.call steps,
onComplete -- SYNCHRONOUSLY for every track it crosses. Re-entrant destroy/stop from a sequence
callback is unguarded (routed to PRO4); defer teardown to the next frame.
Sequence preset helpers (./sequence exports, return a sequence): panTo(cam, x, y, ms),
dramaticZoom(cam, x, y, level, ms), bossReveal(cam, x, y, ms), timedShake(cam, presetName, ms).
bossReveal captures its return pose at BUILD time -- build it immediately before playing.
Read cam.sequencePlaying (boolean).

## Parallax (up to 16 layers) -- withParallax
withParallax(cam);   // once, then:
cam.addParallaxLayer(id, speedX, speedY = speedX, opts)   // re-adding same id updates it
cam.removeParallaxLayer(id)
cam.applyParallax(id, ctx)                                 // per-layer transform; wrap in ctx.save()/restore()
WrapMode (./parallax export) for layer wrapping behavior.

## Bounds (per-edge: HARD | SOFT | ELASTIC | NONE)
import { BoundsType } from '@zakkster/lite-camera-pro';
cam.setBoundsType(BoundsType.SOFT)                          // returns this
cam.setBoundsEdges({ left, right, top, bottom })            // each a BoundsType
cam.setBoundsRect(x, y, w, h)                               // constrain to a rectangle (rooms/arenas)
cam.clearBoundsRect()                                       // revert to full world
Tuning: cam._bounds.softZone, cam._bounds.elasticMax, cam._bounds.elasticStrength.

## Save / load
const snap = cam.getState();   // { posX, posY, targetX, targetY, zoom, mode }
cam.setState(snap);            // restores and recomputes visible dims
cam.destroy();                 // releases internal state; every method then throws ERR_CAMERA_DESTROYED

## Debug HUD -- withDebug or the ./debug draws
withDebug(cam);   // installs cam.debug/cam.debugHUD + builds cam.debugConfig, then:
cam.debug(ctx);      // WORLD-space overlay (deadzone, lookahead, world bounds); call inside the apply transform
cam.debugHUD(ctx);   // SCREEN-space overlay (position, zoom, mode, per-slot trauma bars, sequence %); call after restore
cam.debugConfig.show.shake | parallax | bounds | ... = true|false   // toggle panels
Standalone (no attach) from ./debug: createDebugHUDConfig() builds a config;
drawDebugWorld(cam, ctx, config) and drawDebugHUD(cam, ctx, config) are the underlying draws.

## Root "." surface (exactly 20 names, v2.0.0 -- D5)
VERSION, CinematicCameraPro, default, FollowMode, FOLLOW_STRATEGIES,
createMultiTargetState, updateMultiTarget, createShakeState, addShake,
addTraumaSimple, updateShake, computeShake, clearShakes, BoundsType,
createBoundsState, setBoundsAll, setBoundsEdges, setBoundsRect, clearBoundsRect,
applyBounds. Nothing else -- this is precisely what the class itself reaches.

## Standalone functional API (tree-shakeable; the class composes these)
Shake (root + ./shake):    createShakeState, addShake, addTraumaSimple, updateShake, computeShake, clearShakes
Presets (./shake):         getPreset, registerPreset, listPresets + EXPLOSION/EARTHQUAKE/RECOIL/IMPACT/LANDING/DAMAGE/RUMBLE/HEAVY_IMPACT
Parallax (./parallax):     createParallaxState, addParallaxLayer, removeParallaxLayer, updateParallax, getLayerScroll, applyParallaxLayer, WrapMode, withParallax
Bounds (root + ./bounds):  createBoundsState, setBoundsAll, setBoundsEdges, setBoundsRect, clearBoundsRect, applyBounds, BoundsType
Multi (root + ./multi):    createMultiTargetState, updateMultiTarget
Follow (root + ./follow):  FollowMode, FOLLOW_STRATEGIES
Sequence (./sequence):     createCameraSequence, panTo, dramaticZoom, bossReveal, timedShake, withSequences
Debug (./debug):           createDebugHUDConfig, drawDebugHUD, drawDebugWorld, withDebug

## Subpath exports (import only what you use; gz, esm, unminified, gzip -9)
Beside the "." main entry, seven subsystem subpaths + "./package.json". Same runtime
identities as their source modules (one engine, no fork). Per-subpath gz weight:
  ./shake     3.01 KB  createShakeState, addShake, addTraumaSimple, updateShake, computeShake, clearShakes + presets/getPreset/registerPreset/listPresets
  ./parallax  1.10 KB  createParallaxState, addParallaxLayer, removeParallaxLayer, updateParallax, getLayerScroll, applyParallaxLayer, WrapMode, withParallax
  ./bounds    1.13 KB  createBoundsState, setBoundsAll, setBoundsEdges, setBoundsRect, clearBoundsRect, applyBounds, BoundsType
  ./multi     0.89 KB  createMultiTargetState, updateMultiTarget
  ./follow    0.71 KB  FollowMode, FOLLOW_STRATEGIES
  ./sequence  7.27 KB  createCameraSequence, panTo, dramaticZoom, bossReveal, timedShake, withSequences  (drags lite-timeline + lite-ease by design -- the only subpath that does)
  ./debug     2.04 KB  createDebugHUDConfig, drawDebugHUD, drawDebugWorld, withDebug
  .           15.62 KB class + the 20-name root surface (no parallax/sequence/debug/presets -- v2.0.0 detach)
Self-reference example (shake only):
  import { createShakeState, addShake, updateShake, computeShake, getPreset } from '@zakkster/lite-camera-pro/shake';

## Dependencies (all @zakkster, first-party)
@zakkster/lite-camera (base CinematicCamera), lite-ease, lite-lerp, lite-noise, lite-timeline.
lite-timeline is reached ONLY through the ./sequence subpath (v2.0.0) -- a class-only
consumer ships none of it.

## Fail-closed doors
Ordinary runtime garbage (a NaN dt, a frame-time spike, a bad save file) can no longer
break the render at frame N+1. Setters validate at the call; the update path validates at
its entry; every unverified numeric fails loud or is a documented no-op. Hot bodies pay
nothing (the doors are two comparisons on the update path; errors build only on cold throws).

dt policy (cam.update(dt, ...) and standalone updateShake(state, dt)):
- Non-finite (NaN/+-Infinity/null) or negative dt -> documented no-op, nothing mutated.
- dt 0 and -0 -> legal no-advance frames (zero deltas everywhere).
- cam.update clamps a finite dt above cam.maxDt (default 0.1s, a plain tunable) to cam.maxDt;
  a dt exactly == maxDt passes untouched. updateShake is reject-only (no maxDt; a large finite
  dt is self-limiting). Set cam.maxDt directly to retune; it is not validated per frame.

Shake profiles (cam.shake / addShake): every numeric (trauma, decay, freq, maxOffset,
maxAngle, dirX, dirY) is resolved to its default then finiteness-checked in the cold entry;
a non-finite field activates NO slot (a NaN decay would otherwise leave a slot alive forever).

Sequence options: createSequence({ blendOutTime }) validates blendOutTime as a finite
number >= 0 SECONDS at construction (a cold door, ERR_SEQUENCE_OPTIONS). The hot path gains
one `> 0` compare on the completion blend field; no other option key is validated (unknown-key
rejection is deferred to a future major).

Error codes (all throw a house-style Error with a .code):
- ERR_CAMERA_MODE     setMode(mode): mode must be an integer FollowMode in [0, 4].
- ERR_CAMERA_STATE    setState(snapshot): non-null object; posX/posY both-or-neither,
                      targetX/targetY both-or-neither; every present numeric finite; zoom
                      finite then clamped (zoom 0 -> minZoom 0.25, not an error); mode an
                      integer FollowMode in range. Validated in full before any write
                      (a rejected snapshot mutates nothing). Snapshot is pose-only
                      (pos/target/zoom/mode) -- shake, sequences, zoom animations are not
                      serialized.
- ERR_CAMERA_ZOOM     setZoom(level, duration): level finite; duration finite and >= 0
                      (0 = instant). zoomAt: anchor x/y, level, duration finite (>= 0);
                      a non-function ease normalizes to null (both call forms).
- ERR_CAMERA_TARGETS  trackMultiple(targets): array; every entry an object with finite x/y
                      (validated at call time; empty array legal, count 0). setTargetCount(n):
                      integer in [0, targets.length].
- ERR_SHAKE_PRESET    registerPreset(name, profile): non-empty string name + object profile
                      (setup path fails loud).
- ERR_SEQUENCE_OPTIONS  createCameraSequence / cam.createSequence({ blendOutTime }): blendOutTime
                      must be a finite number >= 0 SECONDS (0 legal = hard handoff). Validated
                      once at construction (a cold setup-time door).
- ERR_PARALLAX_NOT_ATTACHED  cam.addParallaxLayer/removeParallaxLayer/applyParallax before
                      withParallax(cam). The message names the exact import + call to fix it.
- ERR_SEQUENCE_NOT_ATTACHED  cam.createSequence before withSequences(cam) (or use
                      createCameraSequence(cam, opts) from ./sequence directly).
- ERR_DEBUG_NOT_ATTACHED  cam.debug/cam.debugHUD before withDebug(cam).
- ERR_ALREADY_ATTACHED  a second withParallax/withSequences/withDebug on the same camera
                      (per-instance, single-shot; construction-time programmer error).
- ERR_CAMERA_DESTROYED  every public method after destroy(). Destroyed beats unattached:
                      a post-destroy subsystem call reports this, not a not-attached code.
getPreset(name): a non-string or unknown name returns null (never throws) -- the event path.
shakePreset() was removed at v2.0.0 (no throwing tombstone); use the guarded getPreset idiom.

## Notes
- Migration: CinematicCameraPro is a drop-in superset of lite-camera's CinematicCamera. From
  1.x, add withParallax/withSequences/withDebug for those subsystems and swap cam.shakePreset(n, i)
  for `const p = getPreset(n); if (p) cam.shake(p, i)` (getPreset from ./shake).
- Zero-GC: coordinate conversion uses caller-owned out objects; visible dims are cached properties (no getVisibleArea()); shake (8) and parallax (16) slots are pre-allocated and reused.
